title: Crash Racers
tagline: Race the robot cars, zoom through rainbows and bump for fun!
howToPlay: 🏁 Race three robot cars round Ubud, Helsinki, Montreal, Dino Valley or Stunt Park: drive through the rainbow arch (tap the big ⚡ button, or steer into it with ◀ ▶) for a burst of speed, sweep up a whole line of stars for a little one, and see where you finish on the podium. 🎪 Bumpers is bumper cars with the robots coming round to bump you; hold 🅿️ to park and see everyone's 💥. Grown-ups: hold 🧸 to switch Easy mode off or on. Up to four friends can join from their own devices.
learning: Steering, timing and reading a race map
